senses.gloss: m. pl. (= נסיבבי; preced. wds.; cmp. פָּרַשׁ a. פֶּרֶשׁ) [that which is separated,] נ׳ דחלבא, or נ׳ whey.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 68b">B. Mets. 68ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ ותותרי</he> whey and refuse of wool.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 35b:13">Ab. Zar. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>איכא נ׳ דלא קיימי</he> there is the whey which does not curdle (and which may contain unclean milk).
